title: ForeSeek: Foresight-Driven Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding
title_zh: ForeSeek：面向长视频理解的前瞻驱动推理
abstract_en: Long-form video understanding, as a fundamental yet crucial vision task, is being revolutionized by multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based video agents. However, the retrieval-driven nature inherent to these agents creates a significant bottleneck, forcing them to reactively fetch clips based on local saliency without a global temporal plan. To address this, we present ForeSeek, a foresight-driven video agent that transforms long-video reasoning from reactive retrieval into predictive exploration. Rather than blindly probing the timeline, ForeSeek forms visually grounded expectations over unseen temporal regions, verifies them through targeted observations, and continuously refines its search based on emerging evidence, where failed expectations serve as informative signals for principled backtracking. Furthermore, we develop a two-stage training framework that equips MLLMs with foresight-guided reasoning and efficient decision making. Extensive experiments on five long-video benchmarks demonstrate that ForeSeek consistently improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off of long-video reasoning, achieving competitive or superior accuracy while observing $2.5$--$4.4\times$ fewer frames than the strongest search-based agent. Code is available at https://github.com/harry0021/ForeSeek
abstract_zh: 基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的长视频智能体通常依赖局部显著性被动检索片段，缺少对整条时间轴的搜索规划。ForeSeek 将这种被动检索转变为预测式探索：它依据已观察到的画面，对尚未查看的时段提出预测，再定向查看相关片段加以验证，并根据新证据调整搜索策略。预测落空时，智能体也会利用这一结果判断何时以及向何处回溯。作者还提出两阶段训练框架，以培养 MLLM 的前瞻推理能力并提高搜索决策效率。在五个长视频基准上，ForeSeek 的准确率与最强搜索式智能体相当或更高，而观察帧数仅为其约 23%–40%。代码见 https://github.com/harry0021/ForeSeek。
key_points_zh: ForeSeek 让搜索由对未观测时段的预测驱动，而非仅凭局部显著性检索片段。
通过定向观察验证预测，并把预测落空作为回溯和调整搜索方向的证据。
两阶段训练使 MLLM 学会前瞻推理和高效的搜索决策。
在五个长视频基准上，准确率与最强搜索式智能体相当或更高，观察帧数仅为其约 23%–40%。
